messages:
arjun_pm: Hey @liz_peopleops quick Q — I was on medical leave Dec 27–31 and we had the year-end office blackout Dec 28–30. I ended up not using 3 PTO days. I know the normal carryover cap is 5 days, but can we make a medical exception to carry the 3 unused days into next year?

liz_peopleops: hey @arjun_pm :wave: sorry to hear you were out — hope you're doing better. Short answer: yes, we do allow medical exceptions but theres a process. Please follow the "Request Carryover Exception" flow in the People Portal and attach your medical note.

liz_peopleops: Process in 2 bullets: 1) Manager signs off (mike_manager cc'd), 2) People Ops reviews and grants exception if documentation is provided. We typically allow additional carryover only for documented medical leave, up to 5 extra days in special cases. Deadline to request is Jan 15 (calendar year cutoff).

claire_engineering: Quick follow up — I was remote for those dates and had a regional floating holiday on the 29th. Does that change the calculation?

liz_peopleops: good question @claire_engineering. Floating holidays reduce your used PTO for that date (i.e., if you applied the floating day on the 29th we wouldn't count that day as PTO). The exception is only for PTO days that were eligible to be used but weren't because of medical/blackout overlap. If your floating holiday already covered the 29th then only Dec 27 and 28 are candidates.

mike_manager: I can confirm Ill sign off. @arjun_pm please DM me the dates and I'll submit the manager approval in the portal. Also note: for part-time folks we prorate accruals/carryover — if that applies, People Ops will calculate the prorated balance after docs are in.

arjun_pm: thanks @mike_manager and @liz_peopleops — filing the portal request now. One more: is there any chance for retroactive buyout or payout instead of carryover?

liz_peopleops: we rarely do cash buyouts for unused PTO except in termination/separation scenarios. For active employees, carryover or scheduling time off is the usual route. If there's an exceptional business reason let us know, but expect the first line outcome to be carryover.

oncall-bot: Reminder: People Portal form "Carryover Exception" link posted: https://people.redwoodinference.com/forms/carryover-exception (auto message).

arjun_pm: got it, submitted form + attached note. thanks all :+1:

liz_peopleops: Received — Ill review with People Ops and confirm back here by Jan 10. If we approve I'll update payroll/leave ledger and send you the updated balance. DM if you want to include any sensitive docs.

claire_engineering: super helpful, thx! :wave:
